content.short: OpenSocial is multichain SocialFi infrastructure giving developers modular social building blocks.
content.description: OpenSocial supplies the components developers need to build social applications on-chain, such as graphs and identity, rather than shipping a single social product. Infrastructure plays in SocialFi depend on someone else building the app that attracts users, which has been the category's recurring difficulty.
content.meta: Graphs, identity and the other components developers need to build social apps onchain.
